note: Copy to your project as baseline.json and fill in every value. It pins the classic install the port is measured against: shared/classic_import/extract.py refuses any other archives (the DLLs are for reference only and only warn). Changing archives or dlls is a re-baseline, a deliberate commit. extract names the files taken from each archive (lower-case path patterns, fnmatch); changing it only extracts again. Get the hashes with: py -3 -c "import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()).hexdigest())" <file>
